title.ja: バビロンと刑死者と王の記憶
title.en: Babylon, the Condemned, and the Memories of the King
title.x-jat: Babylon to Keishisha to Ou no Kioku

1.overview:
Waver Velvet is a young man who participated in, and survived through, the Fourth Holy Grail War that took place in Fuyuki.
Three years after the Holy Grail War, he suddenly receives an invitation from Reines EL-Melloi Archisorte, the stepsister of his mentor Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald.
Reines, showing interest in Waver who went into a sizable debt to buy out the El-Melloi class, presses him to tell her the reason why.
Waver begrudgingly starts to tell his tale about when he visited Babylon after the Holy Grail War.
He became involved into an incident within the city which some say witnessed the final moments of Iskandar's life, and he had an unexpected reunion with Melvin Weins, an old classmate.
1.summary:
Waver Velvet, who fought side by side with Iskandar during the Fourth Holy Grail War, receives a visit from Reines El-Melloi Archisorte and Melvin Weins. Reines asks Waver to help her with something as payment for the debt.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 七つの星と永遠の檻[はこ]
title.en: The Seven Stars and the Eternal Cage
title.x-jat: Nanatsu no Hoshi to Eien no Hako

2.overview:
Reines and Melvin bring a difficult case to Lord El-Melloi II involving one of his former students, Mary Lil Fargo.
Mary is the only daughter of the Fargo family, a branch of the family in charge of the Astromancy Department, the Animuspheres.
In response to Mary’s call for her former mentor’s assistance, Lord El-Melloi II and Gray visit the Fargo estate to examine the dismembered corpse of Mary’s father, Ernest Fargo. Quite separate from the traditions of Astromancy, this crime calls for the expertise of one versed in Modern Magecraft. Lord El-Melloi II dives in to solve the mystery!
2.summary:
The difficult issue Reines and Melvin brought up with Lord El-Melloi II was a case involving a former student of his, Mary Lil Fargo.  Mary is the only daughter of the Fargo family, a branch of the Animusphere family that rules over the Astromancy division. Responding to Mary who felt she needed her former mentor`s assistance, Lord El-Melloi II and Gray visit the Fargo estate to witness the dismantled corpse of Mary`s father, Ernest Fargo. Disjoined from traditions of Astromancy, the crime scene is representative of Modern Magecraft. Lord El-Melloi II dives in to elucidate the matter.
Source: crunchyroll

3.overview:
The Modern Magecraft Theories classroom was as rowdy as ever, but there is something wrong with Lord El-Melloi II's behavior. Luvia, sitting in on one of his lectures, asks Gray the reason why, and it turns out it's because his favorite tearoom has basically closed shop.
Lord El-Melloi II heads to the tearoom to inquire on their circumstances, as he realizes work just can't progress at this rate, but when he goes down into the underground aqueducts to investigate, an ominous shadow attacks him. Gray, worried that he hasn't shown any signs of returning from the investigation, seek help from Flat and Svin.
3.summary:
The rowdiness of the classroom seems like how it usually is in Modern Magecraft Theories, but there is something wrong with Lord El-Melloi II`s behavior. Luvia, who had come to visit and attend one of his lectures, asks Gray the reason why, and it turns out it`s because his favorite tearoom has basically closed shop. Lord El-Melloi II heads to the tearoom to inquire on their circumstances as he realizes work just can`t progress at this rate, but when he goes down into the sewer system to investigate, an ominous shadow attacks him. Gray, worried that he hasn`t shown any signs of returning from the investigation, seeks help from Flat and Svin.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 工房と塚と死霊魔術師[ネクロマンサー]
title.en: A Workshop, a Grave, and a Necromancer

4.overview:
Primary Lecturer Wills is an authority in the Spiritual Evocation department. His father, Sir Trevor, owned the Marburry Workshop that utilizes an entire wastelands to operate as a Magical Workshop. However, the Workshop went out of control, causing many casualties including that of Sir Trevor himself, and has gotten out of hand.
Lord El-Melloi II, seeking assistance from the Spiritual Evocation department in order to participate in the Holy Grail War, begrudgingly accepts the request to solve this case.
However, what awaited the entourage who arrived at the mansion was Hishiri Adashino, a member of the Policies department that investigates and enforces rules within the Clock Tower...
4.summary:
Primary Lecturer Wills is an authority in the Spiritual Evocation division. His father, Sir Trevor, owned the Marburry Workshop that utilizes an entire wasteland to operate as a Magical Workshop. However, the Workshop went out of control, causing many casualties including that of Sir Trevor himself. Lord El-Melloi II, seeking assistance from Spiritual Evocation in order to participate in the Holy Grail War, begrudgingly accepts the request to solve this case. However, what awaited the entourage who arrived at the mansion was Hishiri Adashino, a member of the Policies Department that investigates and enforces rules within the Clock Tower.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: The Lance That Shines to the End of the World and the Fairy Eyes
title.ar: الرمح الذي يشع إلى نهاية العالم والعينان الجنيتان
title.x-jat: Saihate no Yari to Yousei Me

5.overview:
As the investigation of the Marburry Workshop continues, lightning strikes a second time, adding a new victim into the mix!
Lord El-Melloi II and Hishiri Adashino find themselves in disagreement once again regarding the identity of the culprit.
Lord El-Melloi II turns to the necromancer Kairi Shishigou for help with his investigation. A fierce beast known as the Black Dog ambushes Gray and Shishigou.
After witnessing the Black Dog’s reaction to Gray’s Mystic Code, Lord El-Melloi II begins to draw conclusions. His next move is to prepare for a ritual, utilizing the assistance of all mages who had gathered at the Marburry Workshop.
5.summary:
As the investigation in Marburry Workshop continues, lightning strikes yet again to create a new victim. Lord El-Melloi II and Hishiri Adashino once again are on opposing grounds concerning the perpetrator of this case. Lord El-Melloi II seeks the help of the Necromancer Kairi Shishigou to reinvestigate. Gray and Shishigou are assaulted by a fierce beast, the Black Dog, that suddenly appeared before them. Based on the fact that the Black Dog reacted to Gray`s Mystic Code, Lord El-Melloi II elicits a certain conclusion. He then starts preparing for a ritual with the assistance of all Mages who were gathered at Marburry Workshop.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 少女とデパートとプレゼント
title.en: A Girl, a Department Store, and a Gift

6.overview:
One peaceful day, Gray heads out on her own to visit Reines. An unexpected turn of events leads to the two going on a shopping trip to Carnac, a major department store.
Gray's lack of experience in such a place leaves her entirely at Reines’s mercy. To further complicate matters, Luvia elects to join them partway through their trip, and the three girls decide to have a tea party...
6.summary:
One peaceful day, Gray heads by herself to see Reines. With an unexpected turn of events, the two head out to Carnac, an established department store, to go shopping. Not accustomed to shopping in a department store, Gray continually is at Reines` mercy. Furthermore, Luvia coincidentally joins the two midway, causing the three girls to start a tea party.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車1/6 汽笛と第一の殺人
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 1/6: A Train Whistle of Departure and the First Murder
title.ar: ريل زيبيلين 1/6: صافرة رحيل القطار وجريمة القتل الأولى
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 1/6: Kiteki to Daiichi no Satsujin

7.overview:
The Relic of Iskandar, the King of Conquerors, has been stolen from Lord El-Melloi II.
In its place was left an invitation to Rail Zeppelin, the train purported to have dealings with Mystic Eyes.
Lord El-Melloi II, with Gray and Caules in tow, heads to investigate this strange train. Many have gathered there, including Hishiri Adashino from Policies, Yvette from the El-Melloi's Class, Olga-Marie Arsimilat Animusphere, daughter of the Lord of Astromancy, and even Karabo Frampton of the Holy Church. The train departs, carrying with it the many agendas of its passengers...
7.summary:
King of Conquerors Iskandar`s Relic was stolen from Lord El-Melloi II`s possession. An invitation from Rail Zeppelin, the train said to have dealings of Mystic Eyes, was left in its place. Lord El-Melloi II, with Gray and Caules in tow, head towards Rail Zeppelin. Various faces have gathered at the train, such as Hishiri Adashino from Policies, Yvette from the El-Melloi Class, Olga-Marie Arsimilat Animusphere who is the daughter of the Lord of Astromancy, and even Karabo Frampton from the Holy Church. The train departs, together with the various agendas of the passengers...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車2/6 神威の車輪[ゴルディアス・ホイール]と征服王の記憶
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 2/6: Gordius Wheel and the Memory of the King of Conquerors
title.ar: ريل زيبيلين 2/6: عجلة غوردياس وذكرى ملك الفاتحين
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 2/6: Gordius Wheel to Seifuku Ou no Kioku

8.overview:
Murder aboard the Rail Zeppelin! Someone has killed Trisha Fellows, and Lord El-Melloi II steps up to take on the case himself, but Olga Marie questions his way of life, as his behavior is far from typical for a proper Mage. Meanwhile, Shishigou and Luvia, under Reines's orders, are conducting their own investigation.
The Rail Zeppelin begins its procession once again, and a mysterious figure appears before Lord El-Melloi II and Gray. Radiating overwhelming power, their assailant is a manifestation of the Heroic Spirits engraved into human history: a Servant.
8.summary:
An incident occurs where Trisha Fellows is murdered by someone aboard the Rail Zeppelin. Lord El-Melloi II undertakes the investigation for the case, but Olga-Marie has doubts about his way of life as it is far from how a Mage should act. Meanwhile, Shishigou and Luvia, under Reines` orders, are conducting their own investigation. The Mystic Eyes Collection Train begins its procession once again, and a mysterious figure appears before Lord El-Melloi II and Gray. The assailant who descends upon the pair with overwhelming power is the materialization of a Heroic Spirit engraved into human history... A Servant.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車3/6 巫女と決意と腑海林[アインナッシュ]の仔
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 3/6: A Sibyl, Decision, and Child of Einnashe
title.ar: ريل زيبيلين 3/6: عرافة وقرار وابن آينش
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 3/6: Miko to Ketsui to Einnashe no Ko

9.overview:
While giving the gravely wounded Lord El-Melloi II an arduous treatment, Gray and the others harbor doubts about the existence of a Servant whose Master is nowhere to be seen. Shishigou and Luvia continue their investigation in London, where they visit Jean-Mario Supinerra and inquire about a serial murder that took place seven years ago.
The respite is momentary, as the course of the Rail Zeppelin has been altered, and the train plunges into the forest of Dead Apostles – the Child of Einnashe.
Gray, worried about the weakened Lord El-Melloi, decides to assist Karabo's group that is acting to correct the train's progress. Furthermore, Melvin, who has boarded Rail Zeppelin after hearing of rumors, joins the entourage.
Olga Marie, barricading her lonely self after refusing to help Gray, finds a 'certain something' in her own room.
9.summary:
While giving the gravely wounded Lord El-Melloi II an arduous treatment, Gray and the others harbor doubts about an existence of a Servant whose Master is nowhere to be seen. Shishigou and Luvia are continuing their investigation in London where they visit Jean-Mario Supinerra and inquire about a serial murder that took place seven years ago. The respite was momentary as the course of the Rail Zeppelin has been altered, and the train plunges into the Forest of Dead Apostles, the Child of Einnashe. Gray, worried about the weakened Lord El-Melloi, decides to assist Karabo`s group that is acting to resume the train`s progress. Furthermore, Melvin, who has arrived at the Mystic Eyes Collection Train after hearing of rumors, joins the entourage. Olga Marie, barricading her lonely self after refusing to help Gray, finds a "certain something" in her own room.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車4/6 泡影の魔眼と目覚める探偵
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 4/6: Mystic Eyes of Transience and an Awakening Detective
title.ar: ريل زيبيلين 4/6: عينا التنقل السحريتين ومحقق مستيقظ
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 4/6: Houei no Magan to Mezameru Tantei

10.overview:
Gray and the Servant Hephaestion clash within the Child of Einnashe. However, they are buried in an avalanche, inevitably forcing a ceasefire. While they temporarily sheathe their weapons, they discuss their beliefs about the relationship between Masters and Servants.
Shishigou and Luvia find out that Trisha was investigating the serial murders of seven years ago, as well as the Holy Grail War, and they recognize the link between her and the Rail Zeppelin. As various speculations intertwine, Adashino begins to reveal her own deductions in place of Lord El-Melloi II aboard the Mystic Eyes Collection Train...
10.summary:
Gray and the Servant Hephaestion clash within the Child of Einnashe. However, they are engulfed in an avalanche, inevitably forcing a cease-fire. While they temporarily sheathe their weapons, they speak to each other about their ideologies about the relationship between Masters and Servants. Shishigou and Luvia find out that Trisha was investigating about the serial murders from seven years ago and about the Holy Grail War, and see the link between her and the Rail Zeppelin. As various speculations intertwine, Adashino begins to disclose her own deductions in place of Lord El-Melloi II aboard the Mystic Eyes Collection Train...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車5/6 残像とオークション
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 5/6: The Residual Image and Auctions
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 5/6: Zanzou to Auction

11.overview:
As Adashino's deductions are playing out, Lord El-Melloi II makes his comeback.
He sees a clue to the identity of Trisha’s murderer in Gray’s testimony and so asks Melvin to delay the start of the Mystic Eyes auction. Lord El-Melloi II plans to seek help from Olga Marie to find conclusive evidence to disprove Adashino’s claims.
Meanwhile, in London, Shishigou gathers Flat and Svin to move ahead with certain preparations...
As each of them reflects upon their own thoughts, the fateful Mystic Eyes auction finally begins...
11.summary:
As Adashino`s deductions are playing out, Lord El-Melloi II makes his comeback. He sees a clue to the identity of the true perpetrator of Trisha`s murder from Gray`s testimony, and requests Melvin to delay the Mystic Eyes Auction from starting. His objective is to seek assistance from Olga Marie, and grasp conclusive evidence to overturn Adashino`s deductions. Meanwhile, in London, Shishigou gathers up Flat and Svin in order to proceed with certain preparations. As each of them reflect upon their own ideas, the fated Mystic Eyes Auction finally begins.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔眼蒐集列車6/6 雷光と流星
title.en: Rail Zeppelin 6/6: Lightning and Shooting Star
title.x-jat: Magan Shuushuu Ressha 6/6: Raikou to Ryuusei

12.overview: Caules Forvedge has been arrested for Trisha’s murder. As Lord El-Melloi II brings the Mystic Eyes auction to a halt in order to divulge his findings, Reines—who is supposedly still in London—rushes to his side. She brings with her the real Caules Forvedge, proving that the perpetrator, disguised as Caules, had been among the group on the Mystic Eyes Collection Train all this time. And so, Lord El-Melloi II reveals the name of the true perpetrator: the former director of the Modern Magecraft Theories Department, the man said to "have had his heart stolen by Fairies"...
12.summary:
Caules Forvedge is suddenly apprehended as the perpetrator. As Lord El-Melloi II causes the Mystic Eyes Auction to pause while disclosing his deductions, Reines, who is supposedly still in London, rushes over to his side. Thus, Lord El-Melloi II points out the name of the true perpetrator.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 時計塔と日常と未来への第一歩
title.en: The Clock Tower, Usual Days, and the First Step Forward to the Future
title.ar: برج الساعة وأيام طبيعية وأول خطوة إلى المستقبل
title.x-jat: Tokeitou to Nichijou to Mirai e no Daiippo

13.overview:
Several days after the incident on the Mystic Eyes collection train, a solemn ritual is conducted within Department of Modern Magecraft Theories for Svin's ascension to the rank of Pride.
Several days after the incident on the Mystic Eyes collection train, a solemn ritual is conducted within Department of Modern Magecraft Theories for Svin's ascension to the rank of Pride.
Meanwhile, Gray cannot shake her uneasiness about Lord El-Melloi II’s imminent departure for distant lands to participate in the Holy Grail War. Deep in thought as she wanders the streets, bustling as they are with the approach of Christmas, she bumps into Melvin.
13.summary:
Several days after the incident on the Mystic Eyes Collection Train, there was a solemn ritual at Modern Magecraft Theories for Svin`s ascendance to the rank of Pride. Lord El-Melloi II looked upon the ritual full of emotion as this ascendance to Pride was while his student was still in his teens. Meanwhile, Gray could not shake off the uneasiness that Lord El-Melloi II would depart for distant lands to participate in the Holy Grail War. While in thought, she bumps into Melvin in the streets bustling with the approach of Christmas.
Source: crunchyroll
